Inline workflowInput 'Design and implement stria: Swift PDF reader with OCR-indexed page store, agent chat pane, and agent-facing CLI (RAG)', workflowExecutionId opus-luna-design-and-implement-review-loop-session-241, intake accepted at step5-impl-plan-review communication comm-003157.
reviewContext.userProblem: The repository is an ign SwiftPM scaffold still named KaibaViewer. The user wants stria: a macOS PDF reader that imports PDFs, keeps the original, stores every page as a compressed image BLOB in SQLite, OCRs each page through agent-gateway into searchable text, shows the PDF with smooth continuous vertical scrolling, a left table of contents pane and a right agent chat pane, persists all chats with per-page and per-PDF history, and exposes a JSON CLI that external AI agents use as a RAG backend (search OCR text across PDFs, then fetch page images).
requiredOutcomes: Rename everything user-facing to stria: package stria, library StriaCore, executable product stria (StriaCLI), executable product stria-app (StriaApp), tests StriaCoreTests; README, AGENTS.md overview, mise.toml, scripts, packaging, .ign and release skills carry no KaibaViewer or kaiba-viewer string.
Data root ~/.local/stria, overridden by STRIA_HOME and the --home CLI flag, with stria.sqlite, originals/, cache/, config.json and logs/; tests and smoke runs use temp roots only.
Content-derived document id (first 16 hex chars of SHA-256); idempotent import; resumable interrupted import; idCollision on id clash with a different hash.

Import pipeline: copy original, render each page (150 DPI default, 4096 px cap), store HEIC (JPEG fallback) BLOBs in SQLite, then OCR per page through agent-gateway; import succeeds with pages pending or failed when OCR is unavailable; OCR is resumable, retryable and bounded in concurrency.
Expanded PNG cache at cache/<docId>/page-NNNN.png, written on app open, CLI page image, OCR and ask; valid files are not rewritten; never used for display.

SQLite schema v1 via system SQLite3 with user_version migrations, FTS5 trigram search over NFKC OCR text with a LIKE fallback (short queries and hosts without FTS5 trigram), chat threads and messages, agent_runs.

agent-gateway at revision c7f269753ec36aca92d429ec13316ba033128967 as the only AI library, behind OCRService and AgentService protocols, with fakes for tests; every call recorded in agent_runs and logs/agent-runs-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.

config.json with render, ocr and agent sections (vendor, model, apiKeyEnvironment name only, dpi, quality, concurrency, prompt overrides), created with defaults and editable through stria config get/set.

CLI stria with JSON output and stable exit codes: import, ocr, list, show, page image, page text, search, ask (--doc, --page, --query, --limit), history, config get/set, paths; agent-usage documentation in README and command.md.

macOS 14 SwiftUI app modelled on Preview, Skim, PDF Expert and AI-assistant readers: library home with import and progress; NavigationSplitView left pane (Contents, Thumbnails, Search); center PDFView with continuous vertical scroll, page field, Go to Page Cmd-Opt-G and last-read restore; right .inspector agent pane with scope picker, citation chips, Cmd-Return send and This page / This PDF history.
swift build, swift test (no network, no credentials), swiftlint, files under 1000 lines, and scripts/cli-smoke.sh with a temp STRIA_HOME all pass.
nonGoals: No riela dependency, workflow files or riela data directory (design-docs/user-qa/no-riela-decision.md).
No modification of /Users/taco/gits/tacogips/agent-gateway and no local-path dependency.
No .app bundle, Info.plist, icon or signing for stria-app in v0.1; release scripts keep shipping the CLI binary only.
No streaming answers, per-call timeout or agent session reuse.
No document deletion and no migrations beyond v1.
No annotations, tabs or two-up display modes in the app.
No swift-argument-parser; CLI parsing extends the scaffold's hand-written style.
constraints: Follow AGENTS.md: English only, no emojis, Swift coding skill, every Swift file under 1000 lines, run swiftlint.
macOS 14+ only, Swift tools 6.0, Swift 6 language mode.
Workers write only their plan's writePaths and only the Progress Log of their own plan file; sharedPaths are read-only.
Workers make no git state changes (no add, commit, mv, stash, checkout, reset, switch, branch, worktree); commits happen in serial finalization.
Only P01 edits Package.swift and Package.resolved; no swift package update.
Tests and smoke runs never write to ~/.local/stria or into the repository tree outside tmp/.
No secret values are printed, logged, stored or committed; config holds env var names only.
Commit messages carry no AI tool attribution or co-authorship lines (repository policy).
Run verification commands in the foreground and keep complete logs with exit codes under the evidenceRoot.
designDecisionsAndRationale: riela is dropped: the user said it is not needed, its manifest has a local path dependency SwiftPM rejects for revision pins, and it pulls heavy dependencies; per-call logging is covered by agent_runs plus JSONL logs.
HEIC at quality 0.75 with automatic JPEG fallback: about half of JPEG size for text pages, serving the save-disk requirement; PNG is produced only on expansion because vendors do not accept HEIC.

System SQLite3 with a thin wrapper and FTS5 trigram tokenizer: works for Japanese and English without a third-party package; the backend is probed once in migration 1 and recorded in meta, with a LIKE fallback.
Queries with any term shorter than 3 Unicode scalars use LIKE mode because FTS5 trigram phrases under 3 characters never match.
View models live in StriaCore/AppModel instead of a separate target so swift test covers app behaviour with the same store and fakes.

Gate G1 in P01 confirms agent-gateway signatures from the resolved checkout into design-docs/references/agent-gateway-c7f2697.md; if resolve or build fails, P05 uses Mode B (unavailable services) and pdf-text-layer still works.
pdf-text-layer is a local OCR vendor id that reads the PDF text layer, giving an offline path used by the smoke test.
Unavailable services persist nothing (no run record, pages stay pending); failed calls persist a run and an error message.
CLI ask always creates a new thread; --query replaces the question as the retrieval input and --limit caps context pages to 1...10.
intentionalTradeoffs: All plans share one StriaCore module, so a wave worker's build can fail on another worker's in-progress file; such workers record 'blocked by foreign diagnostics' and post-join serial verification decides.
P01 writes temporary stubs Sources/StriaCLI/main.swift and Sources/StriaApp/StriaAppMain.swift that P09 and P11 replace in later waves; this is the only writePath overlap and the DAG orders it.
Default vendor anthropic with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is applied pending user confirmation (design-docs/user-qa/default-agent-config.md).
stria-app ships only as a SwiftPM executable; a GUI launch outside a shell may miss API-key env vars, and the app then names the missing variable.
Cache expansion on open uses concurrency 2 and is cancelled when the reader closes, trading open-time completeness for responsiveness.
LIKE fallback search scores 0 and orders by document and page rather than relevance.
supportedEdgeCases: Re-importing the same bytes returns alreadyImported true with no new rows; an interrupted rendering import resumes from the first missing page.
Non-PDF, locked or zero-page files fail with invalidPDF and leave no documents row or original copy.
OCR unavailable: import still succeeds, ocr status unavailable with the reason, pages stay pending, no agent_runs rows; CLI ocr exits 4.
OCR per-page failures are recorded (status failed, attempts incremented, error truncated to 2000 chars) and retried with --retry-failed or --pages.
Model output wrapped in a Markdown code fence is cleaned before storage.
Japanese 2-character queries (for example 学習) use LIKE mode; full-width text matches via NFKC; % and _ in queries are literal.
A newer database user_version fails with databaseTooNew without modifying the file.
Invalid config JSON or values fail with configInvalid and the file bytes are untouched; config set with an invalid value exits 2.
Run log append failure never fails OCR or ask; the CLI emits a stderr warning.
Cache files that are truncated or have the wrong pixel size are rewritten.
Rotated pages render with swapped dimensions; oversized pages are capped at maxPixelDimension.
--help and --version do not create the data root; --home beats STRIA_HOME.
Ask with no relevant pages exits 3 noRelevantPages, calls no model and persists nothing.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Password-protected PDFs that require a password to open (rejected as invalidPDF, no unlock flow).
Document deletion or cache garbage collection beyond 'cache/ is safe to delete'.
Schema downgrade or migrations beyond v1.
Streaming partial answers, per-call timeouts and cancellation of an in-flight model call.
Signed .app distribution and environment propagation for GUI launches outside a shell.
Live vendor calls in tests; the agent-gateway call path is verified only by build and manual use.
